text:
jess_support: FYI QuantaHealth just opened CH-4821 — reporting p95 latency jump on their dedicated pool in us-west-2c starting ~2024-11-08T12:28Z. Customer visible impact, they asked to escalate to product. attaching short sample from ticket.

ben_park: got it. can you paste the p95 numbers and model they run?

jess_support: from the ticket: p50 ~180ms, p95 ~2.1s (used to be ~450ms). Model: open-llm/gpt-small-v2 (cpu-quantized variant served on their dedicated g4s). Token lengths ~120-220. QPS low (~6-8), spike correlates with deploy window at ~12:25UTC per customer.

carla_ruiz: is this only QuantaHealth or are other customers on that pool affected? any alerts from autoscaler?

infra-bot: [autoscaler] pool:d-ed-uw2c: scale events: no scale-up since 11:30UTC; last deploy event at 12:24:18UTC -> image: runtime:v2.11.3

alice_chen: quick check of metrics: GPU util mostly idle, but inference node queue depth increased and protobuf encoding latency spiked. KV cache hit rate dropped from 95% to 63% after 12:25.

dave_singh: KV miss spike suggests prefix cache invalidation or model cache mismatch. Did we rollout any kernel/quant change in v2.11.3? deploy-bot, any recent infra flags?

deploy-bot: deploy: runtime:v2.11.3 -> canary rollout completed 12:23:52UTC. Feature flags: enable_dynamic_kv_cache=true, use_batched_encoder=false

carla_ruiz: that flag change could increase encoder latency for short inputs. but why miss rate drop? maybe cache key format changed with new encoder packing.

emily_moore: I'll reproduce on staging. can someone drop a representative request payload and trace id from ticket? jess_support can you add sample trace?

jess_support: pasted sample payload from CH-4821: \n```
{"model":"open-llm/gpt-small-v2","input":"Summarize patient note...","max_tokens":256,"temperature":0.0}
```
trace_id: th-9f2b3c

alice_chen: pulled trace th-9f2b3c — shows encoder step 1.8s, attention kernel 40ms, kv-lookup 12ms. so encoder/serialization is main hit.

ben_park: decision call: do we treat this P1 (customer-facing SLA violation) and hotfix, or P2 (requires deeper root cause in runtime)?

dave_singh: recommend P1 for customer unblock. Mitigations: 1) revert dynamic_kv_cache flag on that pool, 2) enable fallback route to previous runtime image (v2.11.2), 3) temporary increase capacity to avoid queueing.

carla_ruiz: agree. revert flag on pool as fastest action. ben, can you OK routing fallback and capacity bump? then we create a backlog ticket for root cause with priority P1 and link to product.

ben_park: OK to revert flag and bump capacity by +2 nodes for the pool. emily, run the revert and attach runbook steps here. also please create Jira ticket and add product/customer tags.

emily_moore: doing revert now: `infractl pool update d-ed-uw2c --set feature:enable_dynamic_kv_cache=false` -> running

infra-bot: action accepted. plan started. estimated completion 60s.

emily_moore: revert completed at 12:41:03UTC. observed p95 drop from 2.1s -> 520ms within 2 mins. KV hit rate recovering to 92%.

jess_support: customer confirms improved latency and says their traffic is back to normal. they asked for ETA on permanent fix.

ben_park: next steps: create a product/jira epic CH-4821-root-cause -> include tracing, cache key contract, and rollout checklist. scope: audit cache key format, add automated cache-contract test, ensure feature-flag launch criteria (canary metrics with kv-hit guard). Add owner: carla.

carla_ruiz: I'll own the ticket. proposed launch criteria to close epic: 1) no cache key contract regressions in 3 canary rollouts, 2) automated regression test added to pre-deploy, 3) post-deploy p95 regression alerting configured for pools with dedicated customers.

dave_singh: adds to scope: add a canary-only KV hit-rate threshold that blocks rollout if drop >5% in first 15min.

ben_park: fine. priority P1 because customer SLA impacted. jess_support, confirm we'll update customer with ETA (target 5 business days for root cause + fix rollout plan).

jess_support: will update CH-4821 with summary and 5-business-day ETA. marking ticket escalated.

alice_chen: adding note to backlog ticket: include CPU/GPU kernel versions, serializer binary versions, and packer change set from v2.11.3.

emily_moore: creating Jira: https://rwinf.atlassian.com/browse/INF-12984 (mock link). assigned to carla_ruiz, due in 5 business days.

ben_park: thanks all. closing thread for now — reopen if revert doesn't hold or customer sees recurrence. :thumbsup:
